strings.title: Offers
strings.too_many: Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.

empty.title: No offers right now
empty.body: There are no offers available in your country and on your device right now. Please check back later.

unplaced.title: We could not confirm your device
unplaced.body: Every offer is limited to certain countries and devices, and we could not confirm yours. Turn off any VPN or proxy and reload, or try again from a different connection.

no_results.title: No offers match that
no_results.body: Try a shorter word, another device, or clear the filters to see everything available to you.

offer.terms: Opens in a new tab. Rewards are credited after the partner confirms your progress.

note.vpn: Turn off any VPN or proxy. Offers completed through one are not credited.
note.device: Finish on the same device you started on.
note.first_time: Most offers pay for first-time completions only.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: Offers you start will appear here, along with what each one earned.

unavailable.title: Offerwall unavailable
unavailable.body: This offerwall is not available right now. Please contact the app you came from.

invalid.title: Offerwall link not valid
invalid.body: This offerwall link is missing or malformed. Please go back and open it again from the app you came from.

declined.title: Offers hidden
declined.body: You declined data processing, so no offers can be shown and no offer can be opened.

banned.title: Offers unavailable
banned.body: Offers are not available for this account. If you believe this is a mistake, contact the app you came from.

blocked.title: Offer unavailable
blocked.body: We could not open this offer. Please go back and try a different one.

partner_blocked.title: We could not open this offerwall
partner_blocked.body: Please go back and choose an offer instead. If this keeps happening, contact the app you came from.

offer_gone.title: Offer unavailable
offer_gone.body: This offer is no longer available. Please go back and choose another one.

blocked_proxy.title: Turn off your VPN to continue
blocked_proxy.body: You appear to be connecting through a VPN or proxy. Disable it and reload this page to see your offers.

blocked_datacenter.title: Offers unavailable on this connection
blocked_datacenter.body: Offers cannot be shown on this network. Try again from a mobile or home internet connection.

blocked_risk.title: Offers unavailable on this connection
blocked_risk.body: We could not verify this connection. Try again from a mobile or home internet connection.

blocked_unavailable.title: Offers unavailable
blocked_unavailable.body: We could not show offers here. Please try again later.

test_fired.title: Test conversion sent
test_fired.body: A real conversion ran through the full pipeline and your postback has been queued. Check your postback report for the delivery attempt. Test conversions never affect earnings.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: To show you offers and pay your reward, we process a small amount of data about this visit.
consent.what: Your IP address, your country, your device type, and the user ID the app sent us.
consent.why: To prevent fraud and to credit your reward to the right account.
consent.who: The partner network behind the offer you choose. Nobody else.
consent.note: If you decline, no offers are shown and no offer can be opened. Your choice is stored so you are not asked again.
